what_this_is: Fixed probe set for the deterministic-judge cross-architecture decision-agreement canary (sum_engine_internal/research/meaning/deterministic_judge.py). Pairs span clear entailments (paraphrase), clear contradictions, clear non-entailments, lossy compressions, and deliberately near-threshold cases. Expected decisions committed in expected_decisions.json were generated on this repo's dev machine (arm64); the monthly judge-smoke CI canary recomputes on x86_64. Decisive pairs must agree; near-threshold pairs are reported as the known boundary.

pairs.premise: The committee approved the budget on Tuesday after a lengthy debate.
pairs.hypothesis: The budget was approved by the committee.

pairs.premise: Alice adopted three cats from the shelter last spring.
pairs.hypothesis: Alice has cats.

pairs.premise: The late payment fee is fifty dollars and applies after the fifth day of the month.
pairs.hypothesis: Paying late costs fifty dollars.
pairs.note: clear entailment: compression keeps the fact

pairs.premise: The train departs Lyon at 08:15 and arrives in Paris at 10:02.
pairs.hypothesis: The train goes from Lyon to Paris.

pairs.premise: Researchers found the drug reduced symptoms in 70 percent of participants.
pairs.hypothesis: The drug showed no effect on participants.

pairs.premise: The museum is closed on Mondays.
pairs.hypothesis: The museum is open every day of the week.

pairs.premise: Alice adores her three cats and dreads the Seattle rain.
pairs.hypothesis: Alice hates cats.

pairs.premise: The quarterly report shows revenue grew nine percent year over year.
pairs.hypothesis: The report discusses employee vacation policy.

pairs.premise: The bridge was completed in 1937 and spans the strait.
pairs.hypothesis: The bridge is painted orange.

pairs.premise: Either party may terminate this lease with thirty days written notice.
pairs.hypothesis: The landlord can end the lease with a month of notice.

pairs.premise: The city council voted seven to two to fund the new library annex, with construction expected to begin in the fall.
pairs.hypothesis: The library project was funded.

pairs.premise: Water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius at sea level.
pairs.hypothesis: Water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius.

pairs.premise: The medication may cause drowsiness in some patients.
pairs.hypothesis: The medication causes drowsiness.

pairs.premise: Most of the survey respondents preferred the new interface.
pairs.hypothesis: All respondents preferred the new interface.
pairs.note: quantifier strengthening: should NOT be entailed

pairs.premise: The factory reduced emissions by thirty percent since 2020.
pairs.hypothesis: The factory eliminated its emissions.

pairs.premise: She sold the painting for two million dollars at auction in London.
pairs.hypothesis: The painting sold for two million dollars.

pairs.premise: The two countries signed a trade agreement covering agricultural exports.
pairs.hypothesis: A trade agreement was signed.

pairs.premise: The patient's temperature returned to normal after two days of treatment.
pairs.hypothesis: The treatment made the patient worse.

pairs.premise: The novel was translated into fourteen languages within a year of publication.
pairs.hypothesis: The novel was never translated.

pairs.premise: The hikers reached the summit just before the storm arrived.
pairs.hypothesis: The hikers reached the summit.

pairs.premise: The company announced layoffs affecting ten percent of its workforce.
pairs.hypothesis: The company is hiring aggressively.

pairs.premise: Under the policy, refunds are issued within fourteen business days of a valid claim.
pairs.hypothesis: Refunds are issued within two weeks.
pairs.note: near-threshold by design: business days vs weeks
